events.title: 40th Anniversary of Franklin in the Dark
events.description: First published in 1986, join us in celebrating 40 years of the beloved Canadian turtle, Franklin. Discover the series’ original drafts by author Paulette Bourgeois and illustrator Brenda Clark, alongside other terrific turtle tales! Visit the Osborne Collection to experience our exhibit.

events.title: Celebrate 60 years of Mimico Centennial Library
events.description: Throughout November, we're celebrating the 60th anniversary of Mimico Centennial Library ! Take a walk through history with our special historical photo display , featuring images and newspaper articles of the library and surrounding Mimico community through the years. Discover how our neighbourhood has changed and revisit the people, places, and moments that have shaped our community.  60 years of stories. 60 years of memories. 60 years of community.

Come out to build, create and code with Snap Circuits, Dash and Dot, Scratch Coding, LEGO, Magnetic Tiles and more! The club is intended for children aged 6 to 12 years. Due to the limited number of robots, participants may be asked to share with other participants. Drop-in. No registration is required.

events.title: STEM Sundays
events.description: Explore different STEM-themed activities. Drop-in, no registration required. Space is limited. Access and use of equipment will be on a first come, first serve basis. Suitable for ages 6-12.

events.title: STEAM Lab
events.description: Join us for our weekly STEAM Lab (Ages 6-12) , where kids can explore science, technology, engineering, art, and math through fun, hands-on activities. From building simple robots and experimenting with Snap Circuits to creative design challenges and more, there’s always something new to discover. Activities change each week, so there’s always something new to explore!

events.title: Sunday Funday
events.description: Join us for a fun afternoon of video games, board games, Lego and ping pong. Drop in, no registration required. Recommended for ages 6-12.

events.title: Sunday Lego Club
events.description: Join us each Sunday (barring scheduled closures) to build LEGO structures and have fun at the Forest Hill library! For children under 12 years and their families. Please ensure young children are accompanied by an adult.

events.title: After School Club
events.description: Looking for something to do after school? Come out to our After School Club and learn new things, make stuff, meet other kids, and have fun!  Drop-in. For ages 6-12. Note: Snacks are offered during the After School Club for participants. Food may contain or have come into contact with common allergens. Ingredient lists will be available. Snacks are generously supported, in part by donors.  Please note that this is a drop-in program, but space is limited.

events.description: Morningside library's Tween/Teen Book Club!  Come join us every other month to discuss an exciting book in a fun & friendly atmosphere!  Light refreshments will be available. *NEW* Now including tweens! events.title: Robotics Workshops for Youth
events.description: Join Upper Toronto Community Robotics for accessible, hands-on robotics and engineering workshops for youth! These programs will help you build foundational skills in engineering design, safety, CAD software, 3D modeling, and introductory robotics coding. This program is for youth in grades 6-12. It is highly recommended to attend each session to build on your learning. Please register online.

events.title: Sunday Social Art Hub
events.description: Create your masterpiece using acrylic paint.  Learn how to make zentagles or enjoy colouring.

events.title: Silent Book Club
events.description: Join us on the first Tuesday of the month for Silent Book Club. Bring your own book, or choose something from our collection, and spend some time silently reading together. Afterwards, we'll all discuss what we were reading together! Drop in, no registration required!

events.title: D&D for Teens: On-going Campaign
events.description: Play Dungeons and Dragons! Slay monsters and overcome challenges with a Librarian as your Dungeon Master. Ongoing Campaign. This is an in-person program for Teens . Space limited for players*, but watchers are welcome too. All supplies provided. Bring a 1st level character or pick a Pre-generated character. *Register in-person at the Youth Hub at 3:30PM.
